_doc: LANCE-19 batch 6: Small Military Car (HBS) (Shiaic3D) as the ambulance; 3 axles, front steers; neutral medical marking.
notes: Vehicle rework (LANCE-19 batch 6, 2026-10-31), differs from the mech text above: no joints or actuators. The fit is level (`no_icp` in ambulance_veh.json). Parts split by `tools/art/v3/veh_prep.py` (ambulance_prep.json). Welded at 3 mm and planar-dissolved at 1.5 degrees, collapse only above 80k faces a part (no Blender collapse on shell soup). Own-geometry wheels (`make_wheel`: tyre drum, recessed rim, hub boss, bolts) where there are wheels; they are part of the derivative. WHEELED, 3 axles, front pair under `steer_*` pivots. Red cross emblem (protected under the Geneva Conventions) used as in the 2001 original; Lee accepted the risk on 2026-10-31: a red cross on a white circle on both sides and the roof, painted as fixed colours (`fixed_colour` in ambulance.json, not team colour). No turret. The roof's vent louvres under the white disc are pressed flat (`flatten` axis z) so the roof disc reads clean.
